$comment: Frontend only. The Nest backend runs on Fly.io (fly.toml + docs/ops/DEPLOY_VERCEL_FLY.md);
this project must never build or run a backend service or container.
There are deliberately NO rewrites here. /socket.io, /auth/oauth and /uploads are
proxied in src/middleware.ts instead, for two reasons found the hard way:
- middleware runs before next.config rewrites and its matcher is a catch-all, so as
next.config rewrites these paths were answered with the Next.js 404 page;
- Vercel resolves ${VAR} in vercel.json destinations at the routing layer and did not
expand API_URL, so a hardcoded hostname there would lose the single-switch
property that makes the later Hetzner move a one-variable change.
Lives at apps/frontend/vercel.json, not the repo root: Root Directory is apps/frontend
and Vercel reads vercel.json from inside it.
